effects: The signer sends exactly `assets` USDC (0xaf88…5831) to the vault, using the signer's USDC allowance to the vault (OZ ERC4626._deposit safeTransferFrom(caller → vault)).
The vault mints bbqUSDC shares to `receiver`. The share count = assets converted at the vault's stored share price, rounded down, after interest accrues.
The vault then supplies the USDC to Morpho Blue (0x6c24…). This does not touch the signer's balances directly.
formats.shown: Deposit: 'Deposit asset' with the exact USDC amount, 'Share ticker' bbqUSDC as a constant, and 'Send shares to' the receiver; no share amount.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many bbqUSDC shares the receiver gets; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 0: the signer received 9966.703256942429423424 bbqUSDC, and the screen shows only 'Share ticker: bbqUSDC'. The reader listed 'Number of bbqUSDC shares I will get' as unsure.
findings.fix: No calldata value holds the share count, and ERC-4626 deposit has no minShares parameter. Nothing in the descriptor can fix this.

findings.title: deposit intent 'Deposit' does not name the asset or the vault shares received.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: `"intent": "Deposit"`, and there is no interpolatedIntent. The USDC amount and the bbqUSDC ticker appear only in the fields.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Deposit USDC into bbqUSDC vault". Add the interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} for bbqUSDC shares to {receiver}".

cases.notes: The screen shows the USDC out exactly. For the bbqUSDC in, it shows the ticker and the receiver (the signer) but not the amount, which comes from vault storage.

effects: The signer pays USDC to the vault. The amount = shares converted at the vault's stored share price, rounded up. The calldata does not contain it, and no maximum is enforced.
The vault mints exactly `shares` bbqUSDC to `receiver`, which can be an address other than the signer.
The USDC is supplied to Morpho Blue. The signer's allowance to the vault is spent.
formats.shown: Mint: 'Deposit asset: USDC' (ticker only, no amount), 'Minted shares' with the exact bbqUSDC amount, and 'Mint shares to' the receiver.

findings.title: mint shows no USDC amount paid; the vault derives it from storage with no cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);`. Case 1: the signer sent 0.000001 USDC, but the screen field 'Deposit asset' shows only 'USDC'. The reader said 'USDC, amount not shown'.
findings.fix: ERC-4626 mint has no maxAssets parameter, so the descriptor cannot show a bound. Keep the share amount and the receiver, and tell users that the USDC cost depends on the vault price.

findings.title: mint intent 'Mint' hides that the signer pays USDC; the 'Deposit asset' label shows only a ticker.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`, and the field `{"label": "Deposit asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}`. In the deposit format, the same label holds an amount.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Deposit USDC to mint bbqUSDC shares". Rename the field to "Pay with". Add the interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} for USDC to {receiver}".

cases.notes: The screen shows USDC as the asset paid, but not the amount (0.000001 USDC). The shares went to 0xdead, which the screen showed and the reader understood.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns bbqUSDC shares from `owner`. The share count = assets converted at the stored share price, rounded up. If owner ≠ signer, the vault spends owner's share allowance to the signer.
The vault withdraws `assets` USDC from Morpho Blue and sends exactly that amount to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Withdraw: 'Withdraw exactly' with the USDC amount, 'To' the receiver, and 'Owner' the owner; no share amount.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many bbqUSDC shares the vault burns from the owner.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);`. Case 2: the vault burned 1.264091240761512504 bbqUSDC from the signer, and no field states it.
findings.fix: ERC-4626 withdraw has no maxShares parameter, so the descriptor cannot show it. You may add a constant field 'Burns shares of: bbqUSDC' to name the position that shrinks.

findings.title: withdraw intent 'Withdraw' does not name USDC or the bbqUSDC vault position used.
findings.evidence: descriptor withdraw format: `"intent": "Withdraw"`, and there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Set the intent to "Withdraw USDC from bbqUSDC vault". Add the interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver}".

cases.notes: The screen shows the USDC in exactly, to the signer. The reader inferred the bbqUSDC burn, but the screen gives no amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` bbqUSDC from `owner`. If owner ≠ signer, the vault spends owner's share allowance to the signer.
The vault sends USDC to `receiver`. The amount = shares converted at the stored share price, rounded down, and no minimum is enforced.
formats.shown: Redeem: 'Shares to redeem' with the bbqUSDC amount, 'To' the receiver, and 'Owner' the owner. Nothing names the asset received or its amount.

findings.title: redeem never names USDC as the asset the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem format: the fields are only `shares`, `receiver` and `owner`, and the intent is "Redeem". Case 3: the signer received 0.243065 USDC. The reader wrote 'Underlying asset (presumably USDC) ... exact amount not shown'.
findings.fix: Add the field {"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}, and set the intent to "Redeem bbqUSDC shares for USDC".

findings.title: redeem shows no USDC amount received; the vault price decides it, with no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. Case 3: the signer received 0.243065 USDC, and the screen shows no amount.
findings.fix: ERC-4626 redeem has no minAssets parameter, so the descriptor cannot show a bound.

cases.notes: The screen shows the bbqUSDC burn exactly. It does not name the USDC in or its amount, and the reader guessed the asset.
